_help: Copied to config.json on first run. Set the folders you want indexed in the app's Settings tab, or put them in roots here (use \\ or / in Windows paths) and restart. Leave quarantine empty to use a _quarantine folder next to the app. See README.md.

hub._help: Optional. Pairs with U1 Print Hub so "Mark for print" sends files to the Hub's Models tab. Paste the Hub's models.explorerToken here. Leave token empty if you don't use the Hub.
